data.spiritual_significance: The name Kacie, meaning 'pure' or 'rejoicing', is a reminder of the spiritual ideals that Christians strive to uphold. Purity of heart, purity of thought, and purity of action are some of the ways in which Christians seek to live their lives. The name Kacie, therefore, is not just an attractive or nice-sounding name, but a reminder of the spiritual journey and ideals that Christians are called to pursue.
